\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Tensorization}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Bobkov.Tensorization
\section{Overview}
An extended Bobkov functional includes arbitrary additional coordinate functions alongside the discrete gradient. Symmetric pair contraction tensorizes, yielding contraction under simultaneous noise in all coordinates.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Extended profile-gradient functional]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.extendedFunctional}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc,BooleanAnalysis.derivative,BooleanAnalysis.expect}
For $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and $g=(g_1,\ldots,g_m)$ of real functions on the cube, write $V(f,g)(x)=(D_1f(x),\ldots,D_nf(x),g_1(x),\ldots,g_m(x))$ and $F_P(f,g)=\mathbb E\sqrt{P(f)^2+\|V(f,g)\|_2^2}$, with $D_i$ the coordinate half-difference. The extended functional is $F_P(f,g)$ for arbitrary $n,m\ge0$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Gradient and additional coordinate vector]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.lengthVector}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube,BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc,BooleanAnalysis.derivative}
For $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, $m\ge0$, and real cube functions $g_1,\ldots,g_m$, define $V(f,g)(x)=(D_1f(x),\ldots,D_nf(x),g_1(x),\ldots,g_m(x))$, where $D_i$ is the coordinate half-difference.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Squared combined vector length]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.sum_sq_lengthVector}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube,BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.lengthVector,BooleanAnalysis.derivative}

For $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and $g=(g_1,\ldots,g_m)$ of real functions on the cube, write $V(f,g)(x)=(D_1f(x),\ldots,D_nf(x),g_1(x),\ldots,g_m(x))$ and $F_P(f,g)=\mathbb E\sqrt{P(f)^2+\|V(f,g)\|_2^2}$, with $D_i$ the coordinate half-difference. For every $x$, $\|V(f,g)(x)\|_2^2=\sum_i(D_i f(x))^2+\sum_jg_j(x)^2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Length under a coordinate restriction]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.BobkovInterpolation.extended_length_snoc}

For a profile $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, a real function $h$ on a uniform Boolean cube, and a vector $k$ of real functions on that cube, put $V(h,k)(x)=((D_i h(x))_i,(k_j(x))_j)$ and $F_P(h,k)=\mathbb E\sqrt{P(h)^2+\|V(h,k)\|_2^2}$, where $D_i$ is the coordinate half-difference. Let $f$ be a real function and $g$ a vector of $m$ real functions on $\{0,1\}^{n+1}$. Put $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$, $g_b(x)=g(x,b)$, $a_f=(f_0+f_1)/2$, $d_f=(f_0-f_1)/2$, and define $a_g,d_g$ componentwise. For every $x,b$, $\sqrt{P(f(x,b))^2+\|V(f,g)(x,b)\|_2^2}=\sqrt{P(f_b(x))^2+d_f(x)^2+\|V(f_b,g_b)(x)\|_2^2}$.
\end{lemma}

Let $T_\rho$ denote Boolean noise with real correlation $\rho$, whose Fourier multiplier on a set of size $k$ is $\rho^k$. \end{lemma}

For $P:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and $g=(g_1,\ldots,g_m)$ of real functions on the cube, write $V(f,g)(x)=(D_1f(x),\ldots,D_nf(x),g_1(x),\ldots,g_m(x))$ and $F_P(f,g)=\mathbb E\sqrt{P(f)^2+\|V(f,g)\|_2^2}$, with $D_i$ the coordinate half-difference. Assume $P\ge0$ on $[0,1]$ and, whenever $z\pm d\in[0,1]$, $P(z)\le\bigl(\sqrt{P(z+d)^2+d^2}+\sqrt{P(z-d)^2+d^2}\bigr)/2$.
